targetTexts.1: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. O LORD, You have searched me and known me.
targetTexts.2: You know when I sit and when I rise; You understand my thoughts from afar.
targetTexts.3: You search out my path and my lying down; You are aware of all my ways.
targetTexts.4: Even before a word is on my tongue, You know all about it, O LORD.
targetTexts.5: You hem me in behind and before; You have laid Your hand upon me.
targetTexts.6: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me, too lofty for me to attain.
targetTexts.7: Where can I go to escape Your Spirit? Where can I flee from Your presence?
targetTexts.8: If I ascend to the heavens, You are there; if I make my bed in Sheol, You are there.
targetTexts.9: If I rise on the wings of the dawn, if I settle by the farthest sea,
targetTexts.10: even there Your hand will guide me; Your right hand will hold me fast.
targetTexts.11: If I say, “Surely the darkness will hide me, and the light become night around me”—
targetTexts.12: even the darkness is not dark to You, but the night shines like the day, for darkness is as light to You.
targetTexts.13: For You formed my inmost being; You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
targetTexts.14: I praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Marvelous are Your works, and I know this very well.
targetTexts.15: My frame was not hidden from You when I was made in secret, when I was woven together in the depths of the earth.
targetTexts.16: Your eyes saw my unformed body; all my days were written in Your book and ordained for me before one of them came to be.
targetTexts.17: How precious to me are Your thoughts, O God, how vast is their sum!
targetTexts.18: If I were to count them, they would outnumber the grains of sand; and when I awake, I am still with You.
targetTexts.19: O God, that You would slay the wicked—away from me, you bloodthirsty men—
targetTexts.20: who speak of You deceitfully; Your enemies take Your name in vain.
targetTexts.21: Do I not hate those who hate You, O LORD, and detest those who rise against You?
targetTexts.22: I hate them with perfect hatred; I count them as my enemies.
targetTexts.23: Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me and know my concerns.
targetTexts.24: See if there is any offensive way in me; lead me in the way everlasting.
